notes: Session-level (side=global; Class B 1x1, pooled across cue sides). Q-lock 14 #8. SDT d'=z(H)-z(FA); H=P(first lick contra|contra-cued), FA=P(first lick contra|ipsi-cued); extreme-only edge correction; missing_cue_side->sentinel. is_primary=false.
